newsitem.title: USA: Steelworkers approve Dunlop Tire contract.
newsitem.headline: Steelworkers approve Dunlop Tire contract.

text.p: Members of United Steelworkers of America Local Union 915 have ratified a new two-year, eight-month agreement with Sumitomo Rubber Industries Ltd's Dunlop Tire Corp, the union said.
Approved in voting Wednesday, the agreement follows the union's tire and rubber industry pattern set with Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co earlier this year.
Local 915's 1,550 members approved the contract by a 93 percent margin, the union said.
The union said provisions of the agreement include:
-- An $4 increase in the defined benefit pensions to $41 per month per year of service.
-- An increase in early retirement pensions of $240 per month to a total monthly supplement of $340 for workers 55 or older with 30 or more years service.

-- A $0.35 general wage increase for all employees January 4, 1999. The agreement maintains the cost of living allowance which provides for a $0.01 increase for every 0.26 point increase in the Consumer Price Index.
-- Bonus plan for all full-time hourly employees.
-- Contract expiration date or reopener date brought to April 23, 2000.
A union spokesman noted the union's contract with Dunlop's Buffalo, N.Y., plant expires later.
